component.name: Tomb Launcher
component.summary: A Tomb Raider Custom Level management application

description.p: Tomb Launcher is a manager and downloader for Tomb Raider custom levels. It allows you to browse, download and install custom levels from community sites such as TRLE.net, TRCustoms.org and AspideTR.com.

ul.li: Browse and search thousands of custom levels from multiple community sites
Download and install levels with a single click
Track your play time and statistics
Manage save files and game settings
Supports multiple Tomb Raider engines including TRNG, TombEngine, TR1X and TR2X
